描述_EN: star wars: a new hope was released in 1977. sequels released in 1980 and 1983 were equally successful. the first film of george lucas' trilogies was the most successful in american history and grossed over $290 million. a whole host of toy figures, spacecrafts and toy guns were available, as well as costumes, stationery, bedroom accessories and slippers. this piece of merchandise is made for the film 'episode 1: the phantom menace', which was released in 1999. the films captured their imagination and paved the way for the merchandising that accompanies many films today.
描述_ZN: 《星球大战：新希望》于1977年上映。 1980年和1983年发行的续集同样成功。 乔治-卢卡斯的三部曲中的第一部电影是美国历史上最成功的，总票房超过2.9亿美元。 一大堆的玩具人物、太空飞船和玩具枪，以及服装、文具、卧室配件和拖鞋。 这款商品是为1999年上映的电影《第一集：幽灵的威胁》制作的。 这些电影抓住了他们的想象力，为今天许多电影的商品销售铺平了道路。
